title: Budget Billing Plan
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:41 AM
e If you change the meter reading result, a new result is created with the meter reading reason Move-in.

e Ifthe system does not propose a meter reading result, you can have it estimate a result or enter one manually. In both
cases, the system creates a new meter reading result from the adopted/changed result and gives it the meter reading

reason Move-In.

e Ifthe system does not propose a meter reading result, and you do not enter one manually, a service notification or service
order is created for the current register. For more information see service notifications and orders .

You can also suppress the meter reading proposal or define an interval as required. If you do this, the system only makes a
proposal if the meter reading result on which the proposal is based was takes during the interval. Ensure you have configured the

system accordingly in Customizing under |)*SAP Utilities » Device Management » Meter Reading » Basic Settings » Define
Control Parameters for Meter Reading Data Processing 5 . Ensure that you make an appropriate entry in the Move-in prop. inter.
(Interval for determining default value) and the Display default move-in value checkbox alongside it.

You can find additional information on meter reading data processing in the section on the meter reading component.

Budget Billing Plan

Use

You can create a budget billing plan for every contract involved in a move-in, provided the BB procedure (budget billing plan active)

field in the contract account contains the value 1 (Statistical procedure for budget billing collection) or 2 (Debit entry procedure for
budget billing collection). You have the following options:

e Create budget billing plan manually
To do this, choose the Budget billing plan pushbutton in move-in processing.

e Create budget billing plan when data is saved

To have the system create a budget billing plan automatically when you save the move-in document, make the appropriate entry in
the Create budget billing plan field in Customizing under |}'Move-In/Out > Move-In » Define Move-In Control Parameters on
Contract Level.

If necessary, you can also override the settings you have established in Customizing. To do this, choose |sExtras '» Control
Parameters “Jin move-in processing.

You can choose whether to assign a budget billing amount that is valid for all due dates, or whether to have each amount
calculated by the system.

The budget billing due dates are result from the Scheduling component. The printout date of the first budget billing due date
cannot precede the system date. A joint budget billing plan is created for the contracts in the contract account for which you
specified joint invoicing.

The budget billing cycle is determined from the portion, provided no alternative cycle has been entered in the contract data.

For more information see the section on the Budget Billing Plan component.
